objective: Beta blocker 13 (SHANNON's pick A): the onboarding funnel, an economy event for every coin and sample change, and custom events for early losses, refusals and save trouble.
acceptance_criteria: Ten onboarding steps, each logged once a session
Every change to coins or samples is one LogEconomyEvent, typed by the request or payout that made it
WaveLost (waves 1 to 3), Refused (action, code) and SaveTrouble (status) custom events
Clicks (strike) and power presses are never logged
verification: lune run tests/run; selene; rojo build and check-place; in Studio the events fire (AnalyticsService prints them); the dashboard after publishing (blocker 15).
notes: SHANNON, 2026-11-24: 13 A. Read the Error Report daily once published. Model-load failures stay warnings (they are server events with no player): the Error Report shows them.
